intake.processDescription: A synthetic product catalog emits a signed item-changed callback. Each event should validate the item key and create a draft discrepancy record for review.
goals: Track catalog changes without duplicate drafts

sources.content: Verify the signature and item identifier of a catalog callback, then deduplicate by its event key.
For incoming email, retain the provider message identifier.

intake.processDescription: When a test webshop posts a confirmed return-created webhook, prepare a local return summary for an operator; no refund should be issued automatically.

sources.content: For return-created webhooks, validate the payload and use the return ID as a replay key.
A refund requires a named human approval and must not be executed by a draft workflow.

intake.processDescription: A documented monitoring service sends a webhook whenever a synthetic machine exceeds a safety threshold. Store the alert and prepare a review task.

sources.content: A confirmed monitoring callback can trigger alert intake; validate the device and event identifiers.
Periodic audits can be scheduled weekly.

intake.processDescription: Neue Lieferantenanfragen treffen in einem Test-Postfach ein. Jede neue Nachricht soll als Entwurf klassifiziert und einem menschlichen Bearbeiter zugeordnet werden.

sources.content: Ein neuer Postfacheingang startet die Erfassung; die Nachrichten-ID verhindert doppelte Vorgänge.
Ein Wochenbericht kann zu einem festen Termin laufen.

intake.processDescription: A synthetic maintenance inbox receives messages with repair photos. Preserve each original attachment and create a draft inspection record after file checks.

sources.content: Trigger intake when a new mailbox message arrives and record its immutable message ID.
Check attachment type and size, preserve the original, and create a separate derived copy.

intake.processDescription: An internal test mailbox receives access-change requests. For each new message, prepare a review-only ticket and never change account permissions automatically.

sources.content: A newly received access-request email starts a review ticket; retain its message key.
Permission changes require explicit authorization by a named person.

intake.processDescription: Am ersten Werktag jedes Quartals sollen lokale Test-Lizenzen geprüft und ablaufende Einträge in einem Entwurfsbericht gesammelt werden.

sources.content: Für wiederkehrende Quartalsprüfungen Zeitzone, Werktagsregel und verpasste Läufe festlegen.
Ein Callback eignet sich für bestätigte Ereignisse, die sofort geliefert werden.

intake.processDescription: Each morning at a fixed local time, compare a synthetic payment ledger with a demo invoice table and prepare mismatches for an accountant to inspect.

sources.content: A daily reconciliation uses a scheduled trigger and records the run date to avoid duplicate reports.
Financial discrepancies remain drafts until reviewed by a qualified person.

intake.processDescription: Every hour, compare synthetic warehouse stock totals with a local order table and place any discrepancy in a read-only operations report.

sources.content: Run periodic stock comparisons on a schedule, log each run, and keep the source tables unchanged.
A newly received email can trigger mailbox routing.

intake.processDescription: Ein Prüfer klickt im internen Testportal auf Vorschau erstellen. Erst dann soll ein Vertragsvergleich als Entwurf erzeugt werden, ohne eine Freigabe zu erteilen.

sources.content: Eine explizite Benutzeraktion startet einen begrenzten Vorschau-Workflow; sie ist keine Freigabe.
Nachrichtenversand benötigt eine gesonderte Freigabe.

intake.processDescription: An operator chooses a synthetic date range and presses Run Preview in a dashboard. Return a local draft report without setting up any recurring job.

sources.content: A user-initiated preview is a manual trigger and should not silently become a recurring schedule.
Write generated reports separately from source files.

intake.processDescription: A supervisor opens a synthetic exception case and clicks Prepare Analysis. The system should assemble evidence but leave the decision to that supervisor.

sources.content: A deliberate Prepare Analysis action starts a bounded manual workflow.
A named supervisor must make the final case decision; the draft cannot self-approve.

intake.processDescription: Some synthetic maintenance requests are emailed while others arrive in an unconfirmed portal. The team has not selected which event should create the authoritative case.

sources.content: When multiple intake channels exist, confirm the authoritative source and deduplication key before designing the trigger.
A confirmed new-mail event can start a mailbox-only process.

intake.processDescription: The synthetic team wants new CRM records after a vendor update, but the vendor integration, webhook capability, and event timing are all unconfirmed.

sources.content: Confirm vendor API capability, event delivery, authentication, and ownership before selecting a trigger.
For a confirmed webhook, verify signatures and replay identifiers.

intake.processDescription: A synthetic requester says the process should run immediately after approval but also only at month end. No one has resolved which start condition takes priority.

sources.content: If event-driven and calendar-driven start rules conflict, ask the process owner to select the authoritative trigger.
A confirmed month-end run can use a scheduled trigger.
